data.name: Charming Smile
data.description: You can cast Charm Person as a swift action with a DC of %1. You can only have one creature charmed in this way at a time. The total duration of this effect is %2 round per day. These rounds do not need to be consecutive, and you can dismiss the charm anytime as a free action. Each attempt to use this ability consumes 1 round of its duration, whether or not the creature succeeds on its save to resist the effect.|DomainCharmDC|CharmCharmingSmileRounds
